Pumpkin Tiramisu
By: Giangi Townsend
Published: Thursday, November 14, 2019 - 5:37am

Ingredients




2 cups heavy cream
8 ounces mascarpone
1 cup pumpkin puree
1/2 cup turbinado sugar
4 tablespoons turbinado sugar
1 1/2 cup espresso coffee
7 ounces Savoiardi cookies
2 ounces white chocolate shaved
1 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice
PUMPKIN PIE SPICE
4 teaspoon cinnamon
2 teaspoons ground ginger
1/2 teaspoon nutmeg
1 teaspoon ground clove

Preparation

1 PUMPKIN PIE SPICE 2 Add the above spices in a small dish and mix them well. Put the mixture through a small hole’s sieve to sift out any large or chunks of spices that did not separate well. 3 Seal in a glass jar and use as needed. 4 PUMPKIN TIRAMISU 5 Prepare the espresso coffee. Once done, pour it into a flat bowl, add 3 tablespoons of sugar. Stir to dissolve the sugar. Let it cool off. 6 Meanwhile in a large bowl of your stand mixer fitted with the whisk attachment, combine 1 ½ cups heavy cream, mascarpone, pumpkin, ½ cup sugar and the pumpkin pie spice. Beat starting slowly and increase to high speed until you reach a stiff whipped cream. 7 In a medium bowl beat remaining ½ cup heavy cream with 1 tablespoon sugar until stiff peaks are formed. 8 Either use 6 ramekin or a medium rectangular dish. Dip the savoiardi in the coffee and line the bottom of the dish or ramekin with them. Top with a layer of the pumpkin-mascarpone cream. Top with another layer of savoiardi dipped in coffee and another layer of pumpkin mixture. 9 Top each serving with a generous spoonful of whipped cream and shaved chocolate.

About

Thanksgiving is just around the corner and pumpkin is on my mind.  Besides the traditional pie, I wanted to venture out and try something different. 
We all love tiramisu, what there is not love? Here is an easier version, no eggs and in just 20 minutes you have a no-bake great dessert for your family and friends.  You can add to the coffee Amaretto di Saronno to give it a more Italian flair, or rum for a Caribbean twist. That I leave it up to you.
Serve it in small glasses for a dramatic presentation or in a rectangular dish. Your new Pumpkin Tiramisu  will be a hit with everyone.
